generate_struct_bindings: generate C++ Embind bindings for a list of MuJoCo struct names
build_struct_header: build the C++ header file code for a MuJoCo struct wrapper class
build_struct_source: build the C++ source file code for a MuJoCo struct wrapper implementation
sort_structs_by_dependency: sort MuJoCo structs by field dependencies using topological sort
get_introspect_struct_fields: retrieve the fields of a MuJoCo struct from introspect data
